summary: Regression test after adding websockets>=12.0 and wsproto>=1.2.0 to backend/requirements.txt. Ran full backend pytest suite (21 tests) at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. ALL 21 TESTS PASSED in 8s including: admin auth (login success/invalid/me/cookie), access-codes CRUD (create/list/validate/add-minutes/revoke/delete/minutes-validation), public code validation, session/state|stop|skip, and — most importantly — the WebSocket flows: host relay of valid commands (set:speed:42), rejection of invalid commands (set:speed:250, arbitrary garbage), queue promotion after active guest disconnect, time-based turn expiry via ticker_loop, and rejection of invalid access codes on ws_control. WebSocket dependency fix is confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: Regression scope only — pre-existing GuestControl.jsx remount bug from iteration_1 is unrelated to this dependency change and is outside the backend-only scope of this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed access codes and delete them in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is stable at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. WebSocket tests connect to ws://localhost:8001 directly (external ingress WS not required). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml
rca of the issue: No new issues. Adding websockets>=12.0 and wsproto>=1.2.0 correctly enables uvicorn's WebSocket support; all four WS scenarios (host relay + command validation, queue promotion, time expiry, invalid code) pass.
